offering_description.value: Curaleaf grows cannabis and makes products for adult-use consumers and medical patients. It sells through its own dispensaries and wholesales to licensed dispensaries and pharmacies. It also operates a medical cannabis clinic in the United Kingdom.

primary_products.value: Cannabis flower and pre-rolls; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates; oral oils and capsules

primary_services.value: Medical cannabis consultations and follow-up care

customer_segment.value: B2C: Adult-use cannabis consumers and medical cannabis patients; B2B: Licensed dispensaries, pharmacies and medical cannabis distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail and wholesale purchases of cannabis products; service fees: Medical cannabis consultations and follow-up appointments

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sells cannabis products to adult-use consumers and medical patients through its dispensaries; OEM / manufacturer: Processes cannabis flower and extracts into finished products for its own stores and licensed retailers; asset operator: Runs cultivation and processing facilities that supply its retail and wholesale operations; distributor: Supplies cannabis products to licensed dispensaries, pharmacies and other wholesale buyers; service provider: Assesses medical cannabis patients and provides ongoing care through its UK clinic
value_chain_position.category: retailer; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; distributor; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and Europe, including the United Kingdom, Germany and Portugal

specialization.value: related lines: Cannabis cultivation, branded products, wholesale distribution, dispensary retail and medical cannabis care

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated cannabis dispensaries; third-party retail: Independent licensed dispensaries and pharmacies; direct sales: Wholesale sales to licensed cannabis retailers and distributors; online: Dispensary ordering websites and virtual medical cannabis appointments
distribution_channels.category: own locations; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Cannabis cultivation, processing and sales require licenses from US state regulators or relevant national authorities abroad.

notes: The exact current state and country footprint is uncertain.
